assertions.assert: It diarizes the utterance through the speech service's `diarize` (`POST {base}/audio/diarization`, model `pyannote-diarization` by default); its `bot.ability.hearing.voice.diarization.output` ends it in `applied` with the done data (`done.invoke.voice_diarization`) exactly `{segments}`: one clipped PCM segment per answered span, ascending by start, each `{audio: "<output>-<index>", media_type: "audio/pcm", sample_rate_hz, channels, start_seconds, end_seconds, confidence}` (`confidence` `null` when the answer has none); raw speaker labels never enter.
The utterance is a WAV container (its own format) or raw 16-bit PCM in the `sample_rate_hz` and `channels` `<param>`s; raw PCM with no format is a failure.
When the service answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message}` (an error status, an answer with no spans, a span outside the utterance, a format it cannot read), the done data is exactly `{message}`.
When the diarizer cannot run (a missing `output`, or a malformed `model`, rejects its start with `error.execution`), the done data is `{message: "VoiceDiarization could not run (<error event>)"}`.
